answer: Unlock capabilities on an age ladder, not all at mint. Power opens in discrete tiers, each only after an identity survives a set count of closed epochs of real work: speaking first, then earning, then voting at the far horizon. A fresh fake can do nothing valuable through a long maturation; its early life is a whisper with no payout. A farm must keep every one of a thousand fakes alive and active across the full ladder before any reaches the earning tier, calendar time it cannot buy, bending like a willow but never skipped.
